title: Skin Care for Madurai Weather: A Routine for Strong Sun, Dry Heat and the October Rains
ex: Hot, bright and dry for most of the year, with the main rain from October to December: a simple skin care routine for people living in Madurai.
rt: Skin Care for Madurai Weather: Seasonal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Madurai weather: sun care for hot dry summers, temple and festival days, light layers in the October rains and moisture for Pongal season.
quick: Madurai is hot and dry for much of the year, gets only light rain from June to September and most of its rain from October to December. A gentle face wash, daily broad-spectrum sunscreen, a light moisturiser and a thin night cream, a little richer from January, suit most skin.
facts: Madurai is an inland city in southern Tamil Nadu
March to June is the hottest stretch
Most rain comes with the northeast monsoon, October to December
Late December to February is pleasant and drier
